title: Enterprise Cross-SaaS Workplace Search: Live Federated Fan-Out vs. Unified Connector Index Benchmark

tiers.name: Tier 1: 100% Live Federated API Fan-Out to All 8 SaaS Silos
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern: P99 = slowest SaaS API (4.2s), 22.5% SaaS 429 drops & poor keyword-only SaaS recall

tiers.name: Tier 2: 100% Central Unified Index Copy (Including Live ERP/HR State)
tiers.verdict: 18% stale live ticket/deal state & CISO blocks copying sensitive Workday/Salesforce records

tiers.name: Tier 3: Multi-Turn Sequential Agentic SaaS Tool-Calling Loop
tiers.verdict: 7.8-second sequential LLM tool loop is far too slow for interactive workplace search

tiers.name: Tier 4: 85% Unified Hybrid Index (Docs/Wikis) + 15% Intent-Gated Live Federated API + Cross-Encoder
tiers.verdict: Recommended: 96.4% NDCG@10, 380ms P99, 0.0% SaaS 429 throttling & -85.2% monthly TCO
